n-kimchi-pumpfun.summary: Coins named Kimchi, after the trader known on X as @kimchi1x. Posts of 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21 say Kimchi joined Pump.fun: a reply from his own account to @Pumpfun at 00:00 UTC on 2026-10-21 reads "let's work" (e3:0), and the Pump.fun Ecosystem account posted that he "BEAT his $40M Trump trade in 1 HOUR after joining Pumpfun" (e3:0). An account named kimchlsol posted at 04:20 UTC on 2026-10-21 that it is committing its entire position, 75% of the total supply of $KIMCHI, to a distribution for eligible community members (e2:1); another post disputes the wallet people link to him (e3:0). Trader posts name the Pump.fun contract CSocnz... (market cap about $33M in one post, e3:1), but that contract, a second Kimchi Coin contract and a third Aura Final Boss contract carry the quarantine flag for an extreme 24h move (pools about 6 to 7 hours old) and are not counted. Five other coins carry the name in their own metadata: a Kimchi (symbol Kimchi, "Aura Final Boss") on Clanker V4 on Robinhood Chain, a Kimchi on pump.fun whose description reads "official kimchi coin", Kimchi Boss (KIMCHIBOSS) and a coin named kimchi on pump.fun, all with pools created between 23:08 UTC on 2026-10-20 and 00:45 UTC on 2026-10-21, and an older Aura Final Boss (symbol Kimchi, pump.fun) whose description names @kimchi1x and which predates the story: its pool was created on 2026-07-27. A post of 2026-10-21 (e3:1) says that older contract pumped to about $7M in the last few days. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: no coin is shown to be affiliated with Kimchi, and several contracts call themselves official.

summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:4). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and three BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11; a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename; and, since 2026-10-20, テスラSI, pool created 2026-10-19 02:34 UTC, whose Japanese metadata says Musk announced SpaceXAI becomes SpaceXSI and describes a 3% trade tax with 30% paid as on-chain dividends to holders). The Tetsuo Super Intelligence coin on pump.fun (TSI, Solana) joined on 2026-10-18 with a pool 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e1:1), which is unverified. Its Clanker twin on Robinhood Chain left on 2026-10-20 after 24h pool volume of $277 and then $0. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink (SXSITBL, pump.fun) joined on 2026-10-19: its name combines SpaceXSI with Tesla and Boring, its pool was created on 2026-10-19 at 03:47 UTC, and nothing seen ties it to the announcements.
